scope: B601 simulation iteration; predefined before new training and evaluation
time_scope: Simulation time, not a claim of wall-clock realtime throughput
selection_order: Require original-position success in the same execution mode
Maximize complete physical task successes over the four validation positions
Maximize validation trials with sustained elevated bilateral grasp
Use lower offline validation normalized MAE only as a tie break
If still tied prefer chunk100, then the earlier training checkpoint
final_test_rule: Freeze one model, execution mode and source hashes after validation. Evaluate these eight test positions once each. Do not select or retune using the final results.
novelty_scope: Offsets excluded from local training, validation and all previous position probes; coverage of original public real demonstrations unknown. All points inside the training XY envelope.
